summary.title: Tech Talks Weekly
summary.one_liner: A free weekly email newsletter that collects recently published software engineering podcasts and conference talks so you don't have to track them yourself.
takeaways: Tech Talks Weekly is a free weekly email listing recently published podcasts and conference talks.
It is aimed at software engineers and engineering leaders.
It is published on Substack and can be unsubscribed from easily, per the page.
summary.summary: Tech Talks Weekly is a Substack newsletter that sends a free weekly email with recently published podcasts and conference talks for software engineers and engineering leaders. The page is mostly a subscription sign-up prompt, reporting over 11,000 subscribers and stating that it is easy to unsubscribe and sends no spam. It does not show individual talks, topics, or a detailed format, so the content beyond the email's purpose is unknown.
